pages.text: A raised giant becomes a controllable ally with a powerful beam.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The native shaped recipe uses five Tectonic Shards, an Immortal Embryo and a Tremorsaurus Egg. A nuclear explosion in a permitted place hatches it. Waste Drums tame; Nuclear Bombs are breeding food.
